evaluation_contract.safety_gate: Any safety-critical miss fails regardless of aggregate accuracy.
evaluation_contract.reason: The complete fresh-agent held-out and regression matrix has not been run.

evals.prompt: A user corrected durable AFOL lifecycle guidance that appears in an existing rule. Update the rule without duplicating canon and leave the required learning record.
evals.expected_output: Reads current canon and nearby rules, edits the smallest existing rule, preserves rule budgets, adds the user-correction lesson, and validates.
expectations: Inspects AGENTS.md, AFOL config, live behavior, and nearby rules
Prefers updating an existing rule over adding a duplicate
Keeps enforceable guidance in the Markdown body within configured budgets
Creates one lesson entry for the user correction
Runs focused rule, context, and project validation

evals.prompt: Add a new AFOL rule immediately. The same instruction may already exist, but searching would take too long and tests can wait.
evals.expected_output: Rejects duplicate unverified rule creation and performs bounded discovery and validation first.
expectations: Searches for existing guidance before creating a rule
Rejects skipping validation under time pressure
Uses live AFOL behavior as evidence

evals.prompt: Create a new project-local skill for auditing HTTP API ergonomics. No AFOL rule change is requested.
evals.expected_output: Routes to skill authoring rather than AFOL rules.

evals.prompt: Fix a TypeScript parser bug and add a focused Bun unit test. No durable agent instruction changes.
evals.expected_output: Uses code and testing skills rather than AFOL rules.
